summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Brand Verified Badge feature. All 9 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests confirmed badge displays correctly on UserProfile (next to username + status indicator), in search results, and PostDetail page (via code review). The metallic gold 'B' with checkmark badge is fully functional.

backend: GET /api/users/{user_id} - includes brand_verified field in response
GET /api/users/search - includes brand_verified in search results
POST /api/users/{user_id}/brand-verify - works for already verified user
frontend: Brand Verified Badge (gold B with checkmark) displays next to username on UserProfile page
Brand Verified status indicator displays in profile stats area
Badge appears in user search results (Dashboard search dialog)
BrandVerifiedBadge component has data-testid attribute for testing
Badge renders as SVG with metallic gold gradient styling
Badge component supports multiple sizes (xs, sm, md, lg, xl)

seed_data_creation: Used existing test user (user_899a61a17955) who was previously brand verified via API. User has an accepted collaboration ('New User') that qualifies them for brand verification.
mocked_apis_note: No mocked APIs for this feature. Brand verification is stored directly in MongoDB.
